text_block_list.text:
On the way home from going out
with Daitaku Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we can totally hit up one more spot, right?☆
Somewhere we don't usually go, pretty please~♪

And so, the spot I brought
Daitaku Helios to was...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A planetarium?! Seriously~?♪
Watching stars, having deep chats☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well then! Shall we dive into the galaxy's ocean!?
Here we go~★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is said that this galaxy contains approximately 200 to 400 billion stars.
Its total mass is..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Zzpyoooo....☆

The moment the scientific explanation in the opening started...,
Daitaku Helios dove into sleep at the speed of light...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my bad♪ I totally meant to listen, but when stuff gets super deep and hard, my brain just instantly clocks out, y'know?☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So what happened with that constellation talk?
Gimme a summary in like 5 letters, pretty please☆
"...It proved to be impossible after all. As I was wondering how to break the news..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Helios-san?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Roburiyama Roburiano!?
Yahoo-★ What a coincidence☆ Is this your fave spot!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes～...
It's one of my favorite spots.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Each constellation has its own myth...
and among them are some of my favorite heroic tales.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? Then, tell me about the parts
I missed while I was passed out asleep!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Understood, if you're fine with me.
Then let us go with the famous myth
revolving around Perseus...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The "Perseus Constellation" represents the hero
Perseus from Greek mythology.
And—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Next to it is the constellation Andromeda, the princess rescued by the hero Perseus.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And the monster slain by the hero Perseus
was the Gorgon. And born from the Gorgon's blood
was the constellation Pegasus...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! It's not as bad as that MC earlier, but
isn't it still kinda complicated? Like, wouldn't a rough,
hyped-up mythology vibe click way better?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna make my selfie legendary, but
is that okay with you, Rob-ly?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Of course that's fine, but...

And so, Daitaku Helios began to put
her own unique spin on mythology.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hero? Or should I say, Hey you☆
I'm the hero "Agemiza"★
Off on a cheerful adventure, and then—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A princess—or rather, a fine lady! Andromedarincho is totally rocking it! I'm so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And that monster's... uh, what was it...?
Gorgonzola...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer. Aren't their names super hard to remember?
Like, constellations make zero sense to me...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Can't I give 'em trendy names too?
Like the Monster and Pega-bae! ☆
choice_data_list: Well... let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"K. So should we put it on the Monster, or mess with Pega-pippi?
Which is more emosh?"

Told that, I think about it.
Which one would be more interesting?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Monster, roger that☆ I'll give it a nice 'simple is best' kind of name♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you attacking monster!
Your constellation name is...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Ursa Major"! You are seriously SO "annoying"!
The name is literally that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We defeated the "Ursa Major,"
and now I'm happypiece with the young lady★△☆彡

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Boom!☆ Doesn't this totally hype you up!?
Super easy to remember, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The 'Umamusume Constellation'...
What an interesting naming sense.
It's, well... amazing...

And so, the original constellation "Cetus-U" was born.
Daitaku Helios had managed to catch Zenno Rob Roy completely by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pega-pippi, gotcha☆
Then I'll glam it up modern-style♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, unleashing the monster-crushing move☆
The constellation soaring from that blood is...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The "Mega Pegas-Stack Katsu Curry Constellation"!
Loaded with calories and fiery hot, hee-haw★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Milady, wanna eat?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I will pass.
It is unfamiliar food to me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
Total vibe killer, major tears~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... isn't a buzzkill myth like this, like, totally a no-go?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios, please cheer up.
Among the constellations...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's also Canis Minor and such.
If you appreciate those constellations...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a doggie～☆ For real, a doggie～★
Time to give it maximum fluffing～!
Daitaku Helios soothed the heartbreak of the new constellation, "Mega-Portion Katsu Curry," with Canis Minor.
